job_description:
Android Developer

About the Role
At X, we are building mobile experiences used by millions of users. We are looking for Android Engineers who can develop reliable, high-performance, maintainable native Android applications.
This role is for engineers who care about product quality, user experience, architecture, performance, and long-term maintainability. Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, XML, and Android tools are important, but we care most about engineering judgment and ownership.
What You Will Do
•	Develop and maintain native Android applications.
•	Build user experiences that are fast, stable, and easy to use.
•	Design reusable UI components and maintainable application architecture.
•	Collaborate with product, design, backend, QA, data, and iOS teams.
•	Diagnose crashes, performance problems, UI issues, and data-related bugs.
•	Use analytics, crash reports, and user feedback to improve the application.
•	Participate in code reviews and architectural discussions.
•	Write tests where they create real confidence.
•	Support the full application lifecycle from planning to release and post-launch improvement.
•	Keep the Android application healthy as the product and platform evolve.
What We Look For
•	Strong software engineering fundamentals.
•	Strong understanding of native Android development.
•	Ability to reason about application architecture, state management, API integration, persistence, performance, and failure cases.
•	Strong debugging and problem-solving skills.
•	Understanding of mobile constraints such as memory, battery, network reliability, lifecycle, and devicedifferences.
•	Ability to build maintainable UI and business logic.
•	Ownership mindset and strong collaboration skills.
•	Clear communication with technical and non-technical teammates.
•	Ability to learn and apply new Android platform capabilities pragmatically.
•	Current Technologies We Use.
Experience with these technologies is useful:
•	Kotlin
•	XML layouts
•	Jetpack Compose
•	Android Jetpack components
•	Coroutines
•	Hilt
•	Retrofit
•	Room
•	DataStore
•	JUnit / Mockito
•	Git
•	CI/CD pipelines
Nice to Have
•	Experience with high-traffic consumer mobile applications.
•	Experience with crash analysis and performance profiling.
•	Experience with offline-first or data-heavy mobile applications.
•	Experience improving existing app architecture.
•	Experience with both XML-based and Compose-based UI migration.
